ENGLISH: This decision will trigger the Campaign Setup event, letting you indicate if you are playing Singleplayer or Multiplayer and letting you force the AI to go for certain country paths.

This is the main menu of the campaign setup feature. This system will let you change certain things about the mod. Once you click the button that exits the event this system will stop being accessible, so make sure to click everything you want to click before doing that. The first option 'Campaign mode' will let you switch between the Singleplayer mode and Multiplayer modes. The second option 'Country Paths' will let you force the AI to go down a certain path in some nations. Without anything selected they will usually decide their path at random or based on the state of the game.

This is the Campaign Mode selector. This lets you switch between the "Singleplayer" and "Multiplayer" modes. The multiplayer mode has some features such as Grants and National Value changing that don't work in Singleplayer, and selecting 'Singleplayer campaign' in that menu will hide those decisions so that they do not clutter your decisions tab. Neither mode disables content, just some MP features that help make the game more fun in MP and stuff. If you are playing with just a few friends the singleplayer mode might still be preferable, but grants and such are locked behind the multiplayer mode.§G If you are a GM for a large multiplayer game and some dipshit selected singleplayer for hehe haha funny moment, just remove the global flag "singleplayer_mode" in a save edit and everything should work again.§!
